records.basis: All rerun source bindings use computed target/synthesis SHA-256 values or repository commit/blob identities; no illustrative receipt is presented as empirical.
Evidence retrieval is explicitly detector-conditioned and recorded as such in SEMANTIC_EVIDENCE_MAPPING.json; no blind/unconditioned discovery claim is made.
The unresolved M13 evidentiary bridge routes to EVALUATION_ABSTAINED rather than false/non-trigger.
Every non-trigger is explicitly scoped to the evaluated historical target and is not promoted to global absence.
Mapping and detector evaluation are separate records; partial mapping for M13 routes to abstention.
